remarks_1999: Backing was originally attached to destroyed "Yellow Birch with Blue," see Appendix II, no. 74. Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977 indicates, "Sold by Halpert to Lasker, 9/61 as Winter Trees '3.'" "VI" written by Doris Bry in graphite to Abiquiú Notebooks title. O'Keeffe wrote: "I myself like the tree so much that I hesitated to send it to you" (O'Keeffe to Edith Halpert, 26 February 1954 Archive of American Art). Titled *Winter Trees III* by O'Keeffe on Abiquiú Notebooks photograph ["III" crossed out, "Abiquiú VI" written in by unidentified hand]. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Winter Tree III

description: Large brown leafless cottonwood tree with extending branches that is enlarged to fill the entire canvas.  Areas of hazy grey and white give a feathered softened element to the winter feeling evoked by the tree situated in a tan-orange background.  Along the bottom edge beneath the tree is a dark brown and orange area that permeates up and blends into the background.
